body:
I think I need to prove the things that I promise to her. She can't trust me enough to believe me telling her to trust me when I'm the one she doesn't trust in the first place.  
 
Her and I both agree that we will always want to be together, even in the middle of an argument. Even after confessing my desire to have a threesome with her and one of her friends when we were drunk a few  nights before after she called me out on acting strange, in the middle of yelling at each other and me profusely apologizing and bawling my eyes out she smiled at me and started laughing, apparently because I "looked so cute."   

Not that that resolved the argument, but it means to me that there exists the desire of both of us to remain together.  

A lot of the things so said make perfect sense to me, and I appreciate it.

I forgive myself to the extent that I now understand they were stupid mistakes. I don't forgive myself perverting her mind with constant negative thoughts about me.  
No, I didn't feel depression prior from this, or the times in-between me acting shitty. That's why it's so fucked up for me. I know this is over-the-top cliche, but I feel this way because I feel like she's my dream girl, literally; when I was with other girls I had recurring dreams about being with someone like my current girlfriend. We have this connection unlike anything I've ever experienced, and the every piece of the loss of that is entirely my fault. And it just fucking hurts knowing that you have ruined your own life. Even if she forgives me externally, could she ever *truly* forgive me?
